messages:
elaine: Quick sync — I'm drafting the v1->v2 client compatibility checklist and a small PR (RFC-ish) for redirects from /v1/models -> /v2/models. Want to align on: 1) redirect semantics (301 vs 307), 2) client shim behavior for missing query params, 3) examples/snippets in SDKs. PTAL: https://redwood.dev/r/4123

sam: strongly prefer 307 for POSTs, 301 for GETs. Also we need to surface deprecation header `X-Deprecated: v1` until sunset. :+1:

anya: can we add a code snippet for the TS SDK? users often hit the 'model' vs 'model:' mapping confusion in examples.

diego: I can add a small smoke test for the shim. which models should we pin as fallback? suggest `redwood-lite-v1` -> `redwood-lite-v2-compat`.

elaine: yes pin list in doc. sample redirect rule (nginx):
```
location /v1/models/ {
  return 307 $scheme://$host/v2/models/$uri;
}
```
But need to confirm path mapping and query preservation.

sam: minor nit, `$uri` can double-append. better rewrite:
```
rewrite ^/v1/(.*)$ /v2/$1 permanent;
```
That will emit 301 (permanent).

anya: TS snippet for the recommended client change:
```ts
import { Redwood } from '@redwood/inference';
const client = new Redwood({ apiVersion: 'v2' });
await client.models.list();
```
Add a note about old client config: `new Client({compat:true})` will auto-translate for 90 days.

diego: created smoke test branch: https://github.com/redwood-inference/smoke/compare/compat-shim (PR #89). Runs locally, failing on auth header today, will push fix.

elaine: Assigning owners: @sam for redirect rules, @anya for SDK snippets, @diego for tests. I'll open the deprecation notice draft next week and add a one-line banner on the docs homepage.

sam: ack. I'll also search Console + quickstarts for hard links to `/v1/models` and update or add redirects.

docs-bot: PR #4123 merged to docs-staging by @elaine :tada:

anya: small ask — can we include sample curl showing 307 + Location header handling? example:
```
curl -i -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/models -d '{"name":"x"}'
```
should show `Location: /v2/models` and `X-Deprecated: v1` in headers.

diego: smoke test green on redirect + auth fix. pushed commit 4b2f. CI green.

elaine: thanks all. I'll schedule a quick 15m sync tomorrow 10:00am PST to sign off on wording and redirects. Agenda: confirm redirect codes, sample snippets across SDKs, deprecation banner text. tldr: PTAL to PR and leave small reviews by EOD.
